assertions.name: p4.db.reachable
assertions.why: 库层断言（负责人、版本、记录、参与关系、会话撤销后的状态）是本脚本的主要证据

assertions.why: 交接的目标用户与新负责人都要是启用状态，版本从 0 开始才能用乐观锁

assertions.name: p7.create.itB
assertions.why: 交接的目标用户与新负责人都要是启用状态，版本从 0 开始才能用乐观锁

assertions.name: p8.create.itC
assertions.why: 交接的目标用户与新负责人都要是启用状态，版本从 0 开始才能用乐观锁

assertions.name: p9.create.itD
assertions.why: 交接的目标用户与新负责人都要是启用状态，版本从 0 开始才能用乐观锁

assertions.name: p15.tempLogins
assertions.expected: 五个临时身份都能登录
assertions.why: 临时身份用于"原负责人/接替人"的真实 HTTP 侧观察

assertions.name: f1.claim
assertions.why: 领取后这张工单成为该 IT 用户的"活动工单"

assertions.name: f2.claim
assertions.why: 领取后这张工单成为该 IT 用户的"活动工单"

assertions.name: f3.claim
assertions.why: 领取后这张工单成为该 IT 用户的"活动工单"

assertions.name: f4.claim
assertions.why: 领取后这张工单成为该 IT 用户的"活动工单"

assertions.name: h1.assignments.minimalFields
assertions.why: 管理员只应看到交接所需的最小元数据，正文与记录必须留在工单权限之后

assertions.name: h1.assignments.values
assertions.why: 客户端就是拿这份编号+版本去组 handoffs 的，错了后面必然 409

assertions.name: h1.adminCannotReadTicketBody
assertions.why: 交接权限不等于工单查看权：管理员拿不到标题/描述/记录/附件

assertions.name: h1.employeeForbiddenOnAssignments
assertions.why: 端点按 TICKET_ADMIN_HANDOFF 把关，普通工单权限不能替代

assertions.name: h1.candidates.excludeRequesterAndAssignee
assertions.expected: 含 IT-B(16)；不含原负责人 IT-A(15) 与提交人(14)
assertions.why: 候选人必须排除提交人与原负责人，否则交接会造出"自己处理自己的单"

assertions.name: h1.employeeForbiddenOnCandidates
assertions.why: 两个读取端点共用同一条权限口径

assertions.name: h2.missingPlanIsRequired
assertions.why: 账号停用后他不能再处理工单；没有方案就停用会把工单悬在那儿

assertions.name: h2.rejectedRequestChangesNothingUser
assertions.why: 被拒的请求不能留下"半停用"状态

assertions.name: h2.rejectedRequestChangesNothingTicket
assertions.expected: 工单签名（状态/负责人/版本/记录序号/记录数/参与关系数）完全不变
assertions.why: 校验失败必须发生在任何写入之前，工单一行都不许动

assertions.name: h3.staleTicketVersionIsConflict
assertions.why: 方案里的工单版本是乐观锁：客户端读到之后工单被推进过就必须重新组织方案

assertions.name: h3.conflictCarriesTicketSnapshot
assertions.why: 冲突响应要带当前快照，前端才能刷新后重试

assertions.name: h3.staleRejectedChangesNothing
assertions.expected: 工单签名不变且账号仍 ENABLED
assertions.why: 版本不符要在写库前被挡下

assertions.name: h4.disableSucceeds
assertions.why: 停用与交接必须一起成功

assertions.name: h4.db.userDisabled
assertions.why: 库里的账号状态才是最终事实

assertions.name: h4.db.ticketReassigned
assertions.expected: PROCESSING / assignee=16 / version=2 / record_seq=3（领取时已写下 CREATE+CLAIM 两条）
assertions.why: 交接只换负责人：状态不变，版本与记录序号各推进一次

assertions.name: h4.db.handoffRecord
assertions.expected: ADMIN_HANDOFF / USER / actor=3 / from=15 / to=16 / PROCESSING>PROCESSING / reason=handoffReason / sequence_no=3
assertions.actual: row=[ADMIN_HANDOFF	USER	3	15	16	PROCESSING	PROCESSING	账号离职，工单转由 IT-B 续办（20261014-121117）	3]
assertions.why: 没有专门的交接记录表：交接记录就是 ticket_record 里一条 ADMIN_HANDOFF，reason 承载 handoffReason

assertions.name: h4.db.participantAdded
assertions.expected: 接替人 1 条参与关系；原负责人历史参与关系保留 1 条
assertions.why: 接替人要能立刻看到这张工单；原负责人的历史参与关系不能删

assertions.name: h4.sessionRevokedBeforeResponse
assertions.why: MySQL 与 Redis 没有天然原子事务：这条断言证明"账号已变更却返回会话撤销成功"没有发生

assertions.name: h4.noActiveAssignmentLeft
assertions.why: 停用后不能留下无效负责人：这份清单是"还能不能停用"的判据

assertions.name: h4.newAssigneeSeesTicket
assertions.why: 负责人替换 + 参与关系都生效，接替人才接得住这张工单

assertions.name: h4.timelineShowsAdminHandoff
assertions.expected: 最后一条记录 ADMIN_HANDOFF，context 含 from=15 / to=16 / reason=交接原因；实际序列=
assertions.actual: status=200 types=CREATE>CLAIM>ADMIN_HANDOFF lastReason=账号离职，工单转由 IT-B 续办（20261014-121117） from=15 to=16
assertions.why: 交接要在不可变时间线上留痕，且对新的负责人可见

assertions.name: h5.roleRemovalWithoutPlanIsRequired
assertions.why: 摘掉 IT_SUPPORT 之后他不能再处理工单，触发条件与停用一致

assertions.name: h5.rejectedRoleChangeChangesNothing
assertions.expected: IT_SUPPORT 关系仍在（1）、账号 ENABLED、工单负责人仍是 IT-C
assertions.why: 被拒的角色替换不能留下"角色已摘、工单却没人"的中间态

assertions.name: h5.roleRemovalSucceeds
assertions.expected: 200，账号仍 ENABLED，角色集合不含 IT_SUPPORT；实际=[EMPLOYEE]
assertions.why: 角色替换是"摘掉处理能力"，不是停用账号

assertions.name: h5.db.itSupportRemovedAndTicketReassigned
assertions.expected: IT_SUPPORT 关系 0 条、EMPLOYEE 关系 1 条、工单负责人=16、ADMIN_HANDOFF 记录 1 条
assertions.why: 角色表、工单表、记录表三处必须在同一事务里一起变

assertions.name: h5.roleChangeRevokesSession
assertions.why: 摘掉 IT_SUPPORT 后旧 token 不能再带着旧权限继续用

assertions.name: h5.roleRemovalActuallyRemovesPermission
assertions.expected: 403（权限真的没了，不只是会话失效）
assertions.why: 摘掉 IT_SUPPORT 的效果必须是"他再也进不了 IT 列表"，而不只是"旧 token 过期"

assertions.name: h5.keepingItSupportNeedsNoPlan
assertions.expected: 200（幂等：集合未变，既不要求方案也不撤会话）
assertions.why: 触发条件是"摘掉 IT_SUPPORT"，不是"手上有工单"；否则只是改个显示名都要组织交接

assertions.name: h5.unchangedRoleSetKeepsSession
assertions.why: 幂等请求不该有副作用：不撤会话、不改版本

assertions.name: h6.oneStaleTicketFailsWholeRequest
assertions.why: 任一张工单的版本变化都必须让整次停用失败

assertions.name: h6.firstTicketRolledBack
assertions.expected: 第一张（按 id 序先被处理的那张）签名与请求前完全一致
assertions.why: 这就是"账号或角色变更、全部负责人替换、参与关系、交接记录必须共同成功或共同失败"的直接证据

assertions.name: h6.secondTicketUntouched
assertions.why: 失败请求不能在工单上留痕

assertions.name: h6.userStillEnabled
assertions.why: 交接失败时账号状态不能被单独改掉

assertions.name: h6.db.noHandoffRecords
assertions.why: 记录与换人同事务：回滚之后一条都不能剩

assertions.name: h6.failedHandoffDoesNotRevokeSession
assertions.why: 会话撤销在写库之后、提交之前；写库失败就没有撤销这一步

assertions.name: cleanup.tempRowsRemoved
assertions.expected: 临时用户 0 行；临时工单 0 行
assertions.why: 清理干净才谈得上"没碰运行前的数据"

assertions.name: cleanup.fingerprintUnchanged
assertions.expected: 运行前与清理后的指纹完全相同（八项计数 + 五条聚合指纹）
assertions.why: 脚本只应动自己创建的行；指纹相同即证明既有数据一行未改
